title: SaudiCulture: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models’ Cultural Competence within Saudi Arabia.

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using the SaudiCulture benchmark, which consists of open-ended, single-choice, and multiple-choice questions covering five geographical regions in Saudi Arabia and various cultural domains (e.g., food, clothing, crafts), to measure accuracy disparities and identify the models' reliance on generalized or Western-centric cultural narratives rather than specific regional nuances.
